title: Topic 13: Travel & Transport - Vocabulary
description: Core words for travel & transport: bus, train, car, taxi, plane, ticket, airport, travel. 8 tap exercises with embedded grammar.
canDoStatement: Name transport, buy tickets, handle simple travel situations
introductionText:
bus = big, many people, in the city
train = long, on rails, from the station
car = your family drives it  |  taxi = a car you pay for
plane = it flies! (airport)
ticket = your paper to go in (bus, train, plane)
airport = planes go from there
travel = go to another city or country
+ phrase bank: by bus / by train / by car |
A ticket to..., please | What time is the bus?

explanations.A1-T13-VOC-Q1: Plane = it flies. Train = on rails.
explanations.A1-T13-VOC-Q2: Taxi = a car you pay for.
explanations.A1-T13-VOC-Q3: Ticket = your paper for the bus, train or plane.
explanations.A1-T13-VOC-Q4: Travel = go to another city or country.
explanations.A1-T13-VOC-Q6: At the ticket office: say WHERE + ask WHEN.
explanations.A1-T13-VOC-Q7: BY bus, BY car, BY train - no a, no the!
